shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rectangular slab/pillar
central anthropomorphic figure occupying the main field
horizontal register band dividing the composition
elaborate headdress-like or ornamental element atop the figure
justification: Both show low-relief figural carving on an upright slab with a frontal anthropomorphic figure, profile animals and a horizontal dividing band with flanking paired motifs, but these are generic monument conventions rather than shared specific motifs. A's figure is a single elaborately costumed standing human covered in dense rectilinear glyph-like panels with symmetrical curled motifs at the base, whereas B presents a stack of distinct zoomorphs (quadrupeds, a large bird, a long-necked bird) around a schematic armless T-shaped pillar-body with an arm and belt, with no glyphic infill or human costume.
